[Unfinished Prayer] Initially holds one of the following special shields; cannot be blocked while the shield is active; regains the corresponding shield some time after it disappears

Elemental Shield: Physical and Arts damage taken greatly reduced; the shield disappears when own <$ba.dt.element>Elemental Damage</> bursts. While holding this shield, periodically fires a bullet that deals <$ba.dt.element>Elemental Damage</> and bounces several times, with damage decreasing after each bounce

Arts Shield: Gains a certain amount of Arts Barrier; Physical damage taken is greatly reduced while the Barrier exists. While holding this shield, deals Physical damage and <$ba.dt.erosion>Corrosion Damage</> to the source when taking Physical damage
Frequency Shield: Disappears after taking several hits. While holding this shield, periodically performs a 10-hit combo
